description.value: A public garden labyrinth maintained by the Labyrinths of Hope Society at Mill Lake Park in Abbotsford, covering approximately 7,500 sq ft with indigenous plantings and a wheelchair-accessible platform bridge. The society designs and builds labyrinths as outdoor meeting places for caregivers and others experiencing secondary trauma, offering a quiet, meditative walking experience. A second labyrinth is maintained at Kwomais Point Park in South Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a garden labyrinth operated by Labyrinths of Hope Society, with coordinates (49.0424, -122.3113) that closely match Mill Lake Park in Abbotsford — not Chilliwack as tagged. The website confirms two public labyrinths: one at Mill Lake Park off Bevan Avenue and one at Kwomais Point Park in South Surrey; it describes wheelchair accessibility at Mill Lake but mentions no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) anywhere. The website contact page lists a phone number (250 879 4646) not present in OSM, and an admin office in 70 Mile House — neither corroborates a Chilliwack location.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but coordinates (49.0424, -122.3113) match Mill Lake Park in Abbotsford — likely a misattribution.
Admin office listed on website is in 70 Mile House (BC interior), far from either labyrinth location; not usable as a visitor address.
Website content is last dated 03/12/2021 across all posts, suggesting the site is minimally maintained.
No address present in OSM record; website describes the Mill Lake Park location only as 'off Bevan Avenue close to the park playground.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The coordinates place this labyrinth in Abbotsford (Mill Lake Park), not Chilliwack as OSM tags suggest — the community assignment needs correction before listing. Additionally, no required cyclist amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are confirmed, making it unclear whether it meets WWC inclusion thresholds.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Mill Lake Park labyrinth is described as wheelchair accessible with a dedicated platform bridge. If community attribution is corrected to Abbotsford, this record may be a duplicate or overlap with any separate Abbotsford-area listing for the same feature.
